messages:
lee: Heads-up: planning a staggered LB traffic shift in the 17:00 PT change window for /chat -> lb-route v4 (LB sticky affinity). Will run a small EU-first probe because legal asked to validate headers before US expansion. Details below; please ack if you want to be on the observer list.

deploy-bot: Rollout job scheduled: job_id=ld-2026-03-21-02, window=17:00-17:45 PT. Plan: probe 3% for 8m, expand 10% for 10m, gate then 25% for 15m (manual confirm), final ramp to 100% over 20m if healthy. Warmup instances: 4 in eu-west1. See /deploys/ld-2026-03-21-02

anya: test checklist I put together:
- smoke /chat/health expect 200 + header x-lb=lb-v4
- canary cohort (users with tag beta=true) should exercise sticky cookie path
- topo tests: sim burst QPS 200 concurrent, p95 < 300ms
- DB connection pool usage < 70%

carmen: auto-rollback thresholds? Also what sticky cookie key are we using to avoid collision with legacy LB?

lee: auto-rollback triggers: absolute error-rate increase > 0.8% for two consecutive eval windows OR p95 delta > +150ms. Additionally, if app CPU > 80% for 2min sustained in new pool, trigger hold and manual review. Sticky cookie key: sticky_v4:v1 (namespaced) -> should avoid collisions.

lee: LB config snippet:
```yaml
lb_route: /chat
backend_group: chat-prod
rollout:
  - name: probe
    percent: 3
    duration: 480s
  - name: expand
    percent: 10
    duration: 600s
  - name: gate
    percent: 25
    duration: 900s
  - name: finish
    percent: 100
    duration: 1200s
session_affinity:
  mode: cookie
  cookie_name: sticky_v4:v1
  ttl: 86400
```

deploy-bot: Preflight results: config lint OK, LB quota OK, certs valid, routing rules compiled. Initiating warmup: 4 instances lb-v4 in eu-west1 warming.

anya: I'll enable a low-sample trace (1%) just for the lb-v4 instances and wire delta charts for p95 and error-rate vs baseline.

carmen: Please ensure we don't mix sticky sessions during probe. Can we set routing so that only users without existing sticky cookie are assigned to v4 probe?

lee: good catch. adding selection rule: probe cohort = no-cookie && geolocation=eu. will add that to the job.

deploy-bot: Updated job ld-2026-03-21-02: probe cohort rule applied. Also note: a manual gate is configured at the 25% step; job will pause and wait for operator :proceed.

ops-bot: Notifying #general 10m before start (muted) and #cs with short blurb explaining limited EU probe.

anya: release notes: https://internal.redwood/release-notes/240 - contains LB affinity changes and known caveats for long-lived websockets. QA has a short regression checklist there too.

lee: observer snippet for the probe (run from any laptop):
```bash
for i in {1..40}; do curl -s -I -H "x-observe: lb-probe" https://chat.redwood.io/chat/health | grep -E "HTTP|x-lb:"; sleep 3; done
```

carmen: rollback playbook condensed for on-call:
1) deploy-bot rollback ld-2026-03-21-02 --to-version lb-v3 
2) run `kubectl annotate svc/chat-prod preserved-sticky=false` to clear sticky allocations
3) scale lb-v4 pool to 0 with graceful drain 2m
4) post incident stub to #incidents and notify stakeholder list ops@redwood

lee: also adding a quick sanity: if websocket handshake failure rate > 0.5% absolute, hold and manual review (we saw this last time).

deploy-bot: Job ld-2026-03-21-02 is WAITING_FOR_WINDOW until 2026-03-21T00:00:00Z (17:00 PT). Operators: lee, anya, carmen.

anya: I'll bring up an ad-hoc synthetic that replays typical long-poll websockets from the beta cohort so we can stress sticky behavior.

carmen: I'll watch infra metrics and watch for TLS renegotiation errors.

lee: final ops note: eu-first probe -> us expansion only if eu completes all checks green. We'll use a separate change window for us-west1 to avoid cross-continent cache warmup noise.

ops-bot: Reminder queued: observers list prepopulated with lee, anya, carmen. Send :proceed to deploy-bot to continue past 25% gate.

anya: ack. I'll be on the window. If anything looks off, i'll call rollback immediately.

carmen: ack. thanks team. :rocket:
